title: Observational Epidemiological Study of Patients Suffering From Systemic Amyloidosis
official: Observational Epidemiological Study of Patients Suffering From Systemic Amyloidosis
summary: observational epidemiological study of patients affected by systemic amyloidosis
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients diagnosed with amyloidosis or asymptomatic carriers of mutations in the transthyretin gene
* minimum age of 18 years at the time of diagnosis
* obtaining informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* nothing
